title: Pocketwire Advance Delivery Speeds and Destinations
content:
A Pocketwire Advance can be delivered to the customer's Pocketwire Personal Account balance or, on tiers that allow it, to an external debit card. The destinations and delivery times for each tier are these.

| Tier | Destinations allowed | Standard delivery fee to an external debit card (USD) | Standard delivery arrives within (business days) | Express delivery arrives within (minutes) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | Personal balance only | 0.00 | 3 | 60 |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | Personal balance or external debit card | 0.00 | 3 | 60 |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | Personal balance or external debit card | 0.00 | 3 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | Personal balance or external debit card | 0.00 | 2 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | Personal balance or external debit card | 0.00 | 2 | 15 |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | Personal balance or external debit card | 0.00 | 1 | 15 |

## Delivery speeds

- **Personal balance** — an advance delivered to the personal balance is immediate and is recorded with the standard delivery speed.
- **Standard delivery to an external debit card** — arrives within the number of business days in the table, for the standard delivery fee in the table.
- **Express delivery** — available only to an external debit card, and arrives within the number of minutes in the table.

## Points of reference

- On Pocketwire Advance Starter the only destination is the personal balance, so an advance on that tier is never delivered to an external debit card, by standard or by express delivery.
- The standard delivery fee is 0.00 on every tier.
- A delivery recorded as standard to the personal balance is the immediate delivery described above, not a delivery measured in business days.
